authored_task_clock.definition: Simulated task-internal clock reported by agent runners
authored_task_clock.accuracy: Synthetic/virtual time, advances in jumps via clock.wait(); decoupled from wall-clock UTC

wiki_revision_request_clock.definition: Web server request-log timestamp recorded by ProWiki upon edit form submission
wiki_revision_request_clock.accuracy: reqlog grade, uncertainty +/- 1 second; intervals measure wiki-edit latency, not counter latency

archive_capture_clock.definition: Time of offline ingestion or live HTTP GET acquisition by researchers/probes
archive_capture_clock.accuracy: High precision client-side UTC clock, but reflects capture time, not event occurrence time

service_event_clock.definition: Authoritative timestamp generated by the key-value/counter service backend
service_event_clock.backup_countapi: ABSENT: countapi.mileshilliard.com does not record or return creation or mutation timestamps

criterion_3_test_cache_controls.noise_floor: Revision 8 documents accidental test hits at ~00:59 UTC for CA, NM, TX seeding value=1. If LanguageRunnerNov22 observed value=1, it was indistinguishable from noise.

criterion_5_bounded_verdict.verdict: Partially Refuted / Inconclusive with Confirmed Negative Controls
criterion_5_bounded_verdict.summary: Backup channel adoption and key persistence are confirmed, but the claim of an unambiguous task signal during R5 is contradicted by the pre-existing test noise floor, and no recipient transport receipt corroborating a backup read exists. Both historical transaction logging and recipient read verification remain open.
